unmatched: Good question. We will answer it personally in your results email, or ask us on the first call.

entries.question: How much does it cost?
entries.answer: Priced on the outcome. Your exact terms arrive in your results email after the first conversation, and there is no retainer.

entries.question: Do I need to be technical?
entries.answer: No technical skill needed. That is the point. We connect the technical to the practical, and everything the system tells you is in plain English.

entries.question: What happens after the thirty days?
entries.answer: Thirty days to a working system, and it keeps working after we leave. You own the brain, the automations and the standards file. Optional check-ins if you want them, no dependency if you do not.

entries.question: Who sees my data?
entries.answer: You do. The system is built in your accounts, on your side. We never publish, share or train on anything of yours.

entries.question: Why not just hire a consultant?
entries.answer: Consultants leave you a deck and take the thinking with them. We leave you a working system that holds your judgement and keeps learning.

entries.question: Can I not just use ChatGPT?
entries.answer: Those tools are brilliant and they forget you every morning. The brain is what makes them yours: it holds your standards and context, so every tool you use starts from you instead of from zero.

entries.question: Does my team have to be involved?
entries.answer: Your decisions, your trusted context and a few introductions. That is the whole ask. There is no performative homework and no all-team rollout to sit through.

entries.question: What do we keep when it ends?
entries.answer: Everything. The brain, the automations, the standards file and the habit. All of it stays with you when we leave.

entries.question: Is this a report or real work?
entries.answer: Real work. You leave with a working system and the evidence behind it, not a document describing one.

entries.question: How fast is thirty days really?
entries.answer: Fast, because the scope is one result rather than a transformation programme. You see the first working piece inside the first week, and it improves every week after that.

entries.question: How do I start?
entries.answer: Start here, at the top or bottom of any page. You give a company address, the engine reads your market live, and a proposal built for you lands in your inbox.

entries.question: Is this a fit for my business?
entries.answer: It fits a leader who owns the decision and wants to move on one result inside thirty days. If that is not you yet, the weekly read is the better place to start.

entries.question: Will you email me forever?
entries.answer: Two emails, ever. Your results, and one follow-up fourteen days later with a better offer. Nothing else, and no drip sequence.
